authority: docs/readiness/2026-09-16-slurp-next-stage-owner-decisions-v1.md (owner rulings 304/307 (2026-10-13), 313 A and 318 A (2026-10-14), coordinator approval of the NX-T R2 design); docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-thinking-core-engineering-base-design.md; docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md
cell_kind: SAME-FLIGHT NODE COLUMN over the per-node reasoning budget -- 3 arms (no twin) paired per row against the delivering budget-3072 arm; claim ceiling nominated
claim_boundary: No benefit, system-level, superiority, generalisation, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim.

contacts.scorer: CPU official scorer jobs over derived copies only

declared_offset.basis: owner decision 313 A: the larger of the two measured same-core A/A offsets

stages.1_columns: bash scripts/flights/nx/nxt_r2_read.sh columns  (stage3_rollout_score --mode perception-branches: one complete official scoring per arm; no number printed)
stages.smoke: python -B scripts/analysis/slurp_nxt_thinking_budget_column_read.py --stage smoke (per-arm per-node decode cost; no countersignature; the sign-off for the column flight)

what_is_not_here: No margins block and no admission: nothing is locked here.

word_rules.CHEAPER-AT-NO-RESOLVED-LOSS: SLU CI95 lower bound >= -1.49 pp and intent CI95 lower bound >= -0.65 pp (decision 190 floors): any loss is inside the design's own resolution, so the cheaper budget may replace the locked one
word_rules.GAIN: SLU CI95 lower bound above +|o| (the cheaper budget RAISES the score beyond the declared A/A width)
word_rules.NEEDS-FULL-BUDGET: SLU CI95 upper bound below -|o| (the cheaper budget loses more than the declared A/A width)
word_rules.UNRESOLVED: none of the above (the interval is too wide to call the budget cheaper at no loss, and the loss is not beyond |o|)
